items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [auto-venv (skylor0tang) (⭐6)](https://github.com/Skylor-Tang/auto-venv) - Automatically activates the Python virtual environment in the current directory or its parent directories.
*   [auto-venv (songlkkevin) (⭐0)](https://github.com/songlkkevin/zsh-auto-venv) - Automatically detect and activate the nearest Python virtual environment when changing directories.
*   [disk-guard (⭐1)](https://github.com/TomfromBerlin/Zsh-Disk-Guard) - Warns you when you try to copy/move/rsync files and are running low on local disk space, and provides useful information and a nice progress bar for `cp` and `mv`.
*   [git-graph (⭐0)](https://github.com/Maks0u/git-graph) - Adds a pretty `git` graph.
*   [ssh-host (⭐1)](https://github.com/obolientsev/ssh-host) - Manage ssh with [fzf (⭐74k)](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf).

### Completions / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [python-module-completion (⭐3)](https://github.com/UshioA/zsh-python-module-completion) - Intelligent tab completion for python -m commands with hierarchical module navigation and smart project detection.

### Themes / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [quantum (⭐17)](https://github.com/calebephrem/quantum-zsh) - Sleek, dynamic Zsh theme built for speed, style, and shell supremacy. Whether you're deep in Git or just vibing in your terminal, Quantum adapts to your flow.

items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Fuzzy Finder / Diagnostics

*   [dmtrKovalenko/fff.nvim (⭐913)](https://github.com/dmtrKovalenko/fff.nvim) - Fuzzy file picker with a standalone native implementation of file indexing and typo resistant fuzzy matcher. Includes all the QOL features, file previews (and images), frecency sorting, last query matching, proximity, git status bonuses and much more.

### File Explorer / Diagnostics

*   [saifulapm/neotree-file-nesting-config (⭐20)](https://github.com/saifulapm/neotree-file-nesting-config) - Pre-defined file nesting rules for `neo-tree.nvim`.

### Project / Diagnostics

*   [cljoly/telescope-repo.nvim (⭐235)](https://github.com/cljoly/telescope-repo.nvim) - Telescope picker to jump to any repository (Git or other) on the file system.

### Tree-sitter Supported Colorscheme / Diagnostics

*   [svermeulen/text-to-colorscheme (⭐313)](https://github.com/svermeulen/text-to-colorscheme) - Dynamically generated colorschemes generated on the fly with a text prompt using ChatGPT.

### Utility / Diagnostics

*   [chrisgrieser/nvim-early-retirement (⭐227)](https://github.com/chrisgrieser/nvim-early-retirement) - Send buffers into early retirement by automatically closing them after x minutes of inactivity.
*   [axkirillov/hbac.nvim (⭐217)](https://github.com/axkirillov/hbac.nvim) - Automatically close buffers you are not working on.
*   [iquzart/toggleword.nvim (⭐3)](https://github.com/iquzart/toggleword.nvim) - Toggle between common code keywords under the cursor such as true ⇄ false, on ⇄ off, enabled ⇄ disabled, and dev ⇄ prod.

### Test / Diagnostics

*   [zkucekovic/tdd.nvim (⭐6)](https://github.com/zkucekovic/tdd.nvim) - Opens or creates the matching PHPUnit test file for a given class, based on PSR-4 namespace mappings.
*   [nvim-neotest/neotest-jest (⭐139)](https://github.com/nvim-neotest/neotest-jest) - Neotest adapter for running jest tests.
*   [MisanthropicBit/neotest-busted (⭐13)](https://github.com/MisanthropicBit/neotest-busted) - Neotest adapter for running busted tests using Neovim as a Lua interpreter.

### Neovim Lua Development / Diagnostics

*   [svermeulen/nvim-lusc (⭐14)](https://github.com/svermeulen/nvim-lusc) - Adds support for Structured Async/Concurrency in Lua.

### Remote Development / Diagnostics

*   [azratul/live-share.nvim (⭐222)](https://github.com/azratul/live-share.nvim) - Provides remote collaboration capabilities from anywhere, making it ideal for pair-programming scenarios.

### Vim / Diagnostics

*   [akrawchyk/awesome-vim#tools (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/akrawchyk/awesome-vim#tools) - Short list of Vim plugins and helpful guides.
*   [altermo/vim-plugin-list (⭐138)](https://github.com/altermo/vim-plugin-list) - List of Vim and Neovim plugins.

### Resource / Diagnostics

*   [Weyaaron/nvim-training (⭐101)](https://github.com/Weyaaron/nvim-training) - A beginner-friendly tool for training your 'muscle memory' using small, repeatable tasks.
